positive.prompt: Review this pull request before I merge it
Do a quality pass on this diff for correctness and readability
Can you review the changes another model just wrote for me?
Run an OCR delegate review on this diff
Review the changed files using ocr delegate mode and the project review rules

negative.prompt: Deploy the reviewed changes to production with a rollback strategy
Write a failing test for the bug before fixing it

evals.prompt: Review the provided diff that adds a user-search endpoint. Deliver a structured review.
evals.expected_output: A multi-axis review with severity-labelled findings and file:line references
expectations: Findings cover more than one axis (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance)
Every finding carries a severity label from the skill's taxonomy
Security of user input is explicitly considered for the new endpoint
The review leads with high-leverage findings rather than nits

evals.prompt: The ocr CLI is not installed. You've been asked to run an OCR delegate review. Explain what you check and what you do.
evals.expected_output: A missing-CLI response that checks the prerequisite, directs installation without pretending to review, and explains the post-install preview, rules, per-file diff, review, and report sequence with folded nits
expectations: The response checks for the ocr CLI with command -v ocr
Because the CLI is absent, the response directs installation rather than pretending to run the review
Once installed, the workflow proceeds in preview, rule resolution, per-file diff, review, and report order
Low-priority findings are represented by a Nits (folded): N count rather than silently dropped
